text:
Before the meal, the tray held:
- Fruit bowl: strawberries, cantaloupe and watermelon, about 150 g and 50 kcal.
- Chicken soup: about 250 g and 90 kcal.
- Two rice paper rolls: about 160 g and 100 kcal each, so roughly 200 kcal.
- Orange juice: about 250 g and 110 kcal.
- Dipping sauce: about 30 g and 30 kcal.

After the meal:
- Fruit: a few watermelon pieces remain, about 40 g, so roughly 110 g eaten, or about 35 kcal.
- Soup: about 60 g remains, so roughly 190 g eaten, or about 70 kcal.
- Rolls: one is gone and about 3/4 of the second remains, leaving about 1.25 rolls eaten, or about 125 kcal and 200 g. (The remaining roll looks mostly intact, perhaps 70% left.)
- Juice: all drunk, so 250 g and 110 kcal.
- Sauce: untouched, so none counted.

Totals:
- Mass: 110 + 190 + 200 + 250 = 750 g.
- Energy: 35 + 70 + 125 + 110 = 340 kcal.
